instruction: Fix `hex_decode` so it decodes the bytes back to a UTF-8 string (the current code returns raw bytes).
gold_patch:
diff --git a/codec.py b/codec.py
--- a/codec.py
+++ b/codec.py
@@ -22,7 +22,7 @@
 
 def hex_decode(text):
     """Decode a hex string back into a UTF-8 string."""
-    return bytes.fromhex(text)
+    return bytes.fromhex(text).decode("utf-8")
